sentences.en: He's so cosseted he can't do anything by himself.
sentences.zh: 他被宠得太厉害了，连自己都不能照顾自己。

sentences.en: The parents cosset their child with too many privileges.
sentences.zh: 父母给孩子的特权太多了，宠坏了孩子。

sentences.en: She was cosseted by her grandparents and never learned to be independent.
sentences.zh: 她被祖父母溺爱着长大，从没学会独立。

senses.zh: 宠儿；爱畜；供玩赏的小动物
